limitations: Quarter-end snapshot predates the October 1, 2026 Global Exchange collateral-policy update.
The filing aggregates several other crypto assets and does not identify XRP.
Customer collateral not recognized on balance sheet is not broken down by token.
Eligibility, haircut and ADQ caps do not disclose actual XRP pledged or utilized.
Policy applies only to supported products, customer types and jurisdictions.

recognized_lending_collateral.interpretation: The entire $9.903M other-crypto aggregate includes various assets and is not attributed to XRP. If XRP is among them, its amount is no greater than this aggregate; actual XRP may be zero.

coinbase_own_assets_pledged_against_shor.classification: Coinbase's own pledged assets; not customer-pledged collateral.

stablecoin_economics.average_usdc_held_in_coinbase_products: all-time high (10-Q does not state exact average balance)
stablecoin_economics.accounting_change_q1_2026: Revenue on corporate payment-stablecoin balances moved from Stablecoin revenue to Corporate interest and other income; Coinbase states there was no change to the Circle arrangement or revenue generated.

relationship_graph.relation: USDC commercial arrangement renewed on the same terms; Q3 10-Q says the accounting reclassification of corporate payment-stablecoin revenue did not change the arrangement or revenue generated.
XRP is listed in supported Global Exchange cross-collateral documentation; actual XRP utilization is undisclosed.
The Sep 30 recognized derivatives-collateral table lists BTC and ETH only; no XRP line is disclosed.

observations.claim: As of Sep 30, 2026, Coinbase reported $1.976137B loan receivables, of which $17.598M were crypto-asset loans and $1.958539B were fiat/payment-stablecoin loans.
disconfirming_or_limiting: This is a quarter-end snapshot, not current post-Oct1 product utilization.

observations.claim: The filing does not identify XRP in recognized lending or derivatives collateral. The entire other-crypto recognized lending bucket is $9.903M; if XRP is included, its recognized lending-collateral amount cannot exceed that aggregate.
disconfirming_or_limiting: XRP may be absent from the other-crypto bucket; actual amount may be zero.
The quarter end predates the Oct 1 policy update.
The $2.804112B unrecognized borrower crypto-collateral pool has no token-level breakdown.

observations.claim: Coinbase reported $306.905M Q3 stablecoin revenue and renewed its Circle arrangement on the same terms. Corporate payment-stablecoin balance revenue was reclassified to Corporate interest and other income in Q1 2026 without changing the arrangement or revenue generated.
disconfirming_or_limiting: The Stablecoin revenue line alone no longer captures all corporate payment-stablecoin balance economics.

observations.claim: Coinbase identifies the everything exchange, stablecoins/payments and onchain adoption as its 2026 priorities; average USDC held in Coinbase products reached an all-time high, while AOP and MTUs were lower year over year.
disconfirming_or_limiting: AOP decline was primarily attributed to crypto prices; it is not a direct customer outflow measure.
The 10-Q does not disclose an exact average USDC balance.

competing_hypotheses.claim: XRP collateral eligibility exists, but material XRP utilization is not demonstrated by the Sep 30 filing.
support: No XRP line in recognized derivatives collateral.
The aggregate other-crypto lending-collateral bucket is $9.903M.
disconfirming_or_missing: The filing predates the Oct 1 policy update.
Unrecognized borrower crypto collateral of $2.804112B is not broken down by token.
competing_hypotheses.test: Seek later quarter-end filings, product-specific utilization disclosures and asset-level collateral reports.

competing_hypotheses.claim: XRP collateral utilization may have changed after the October 1 policy update, but public eligibility documentation alone cannot establish the amount.
support: Coinbase product documentation lists XRP in supported cross-collateral terms.
disconfirming_or_missing: No post-Oct1 XRP-specific pledged balance or loan utilization has been disclosed in the reviewed filing.
competing_hypotheses.test: Compare subsequent quarter-end collateral schedules and public product-specific utilization data.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Coinbase's USDC economics are understated if Stablecoin revenue is read without Corporate interest and other income after the Q1 2026 reclassification.
support: The 10-Q explicitly reclassifies corporate payment-stablecoin balance revenue.
Coinbase says Circle arrangement and revenue generated did not change.
disconfirming_or_missing: The 10-Q does not provide a single consolidated USDC-only revenue figure across both lines.
competing_hypotheses.test: Reconcile Stablecoin revenue and Corporate interest and other income disclosures across filings and earnings decks.

data_quality.no_averaging_or_asset_attribution: Do not assign any portion of Other crypto assets or unrecognized borrower crypto collateral to XRP without asset-level disclosure.
data_quality.accounting_reclassification: Do not compare the Stablecoin revenue line alone across periods without including corporate payment-stablecoin balance revenue reclassified to Corporate interest and other income.

predictions.reason: This filing improves institutional/collateral features but does not provide a verified XRP utilization series or support a directional forecast.

next_actions: Seek post-Oct1 and later-quarter XRP-specific collateral utilization disclosures.
Reconcile Coinbase stablecoin revenue with Corporate interest and other income across filings.
Keep XRP product eligibility separate from actual collateral balances and from RLUSD/USDC distribution.
